sr_title: Group B streptococcal disease in infants aged younger than 3 months: systematic review and meta-analysis.
research_objective: To examine the global burden of invasive group B streptococcal disease in infants aged 0–89 days, including incidence, deaths, and serotype distribution, using studies reporting incidence, deaths, or serotypes of early-onset (days 0–6) or late-onset (days 7–89) disease.

sr_title: Acute cannabis consumption and motor vehicle collision risk: systematic review of observational studies and meta-analysis.
research_objective: To examine the association between acute cannabis (cannabinoid) consumption by drivers and the risk of motor vehicle collision, using observational epidemiology studies with an appropriate control group that measured recent cannabis use by toxicological analysis of whole blood or self-report; experimental and simulator studies were excluded.

sr_title: White rice consumption and risk of type 2 diabetes: meta-analysis and systematic review.
research_objective: To summarize evidence from prospective cohort studies reporting risk estimates by white rice intake levels on the association between white rice consumption and risk of type 2 diabetes, and to quantify the potential dose-response relationship.

sr_title: Comparative effectiveness and safety of methods of insulin delivery and glucose monitoring for diabetes mellitus: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
research_objective: To examine the effects on outcomes in children and adults with type 1 or type 2 diabetes mellitus of intensive insulin therapy comparing multiple daily injections with rapid-acting analogue-based continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion, glucose monitoring comparing real-time continuous glucose monitoring with self-monitoring of blood glucose, and sensor-augmented insulin pump use compared with multiple daily injections plus self-monitoring of blood glucose, using randomized controlled trials.

sr_title: Assessing the risk of venous thromboembolic events in women taking progestin-only contraception: a meta-analysis.
research_objective: To evaluate the risk of venous thromboembolic events in women using progestin-only contraception compared with a non-hormone comparator, and whether the risk differs by mode of delivery (oral, intrauterine, or depot injection), using evidence from randomised controlled trials and case-control, cohort, and cross-sectional studies.

sr_title: Transitional care after hospitalization for acute stroke or myocardial infarction: a systematic review.
research_objective: The review aimed to describe time-limited transitional care interventions and assess evidence of benefit or harm compared with usual care among adults hospitalized for acute stroke or myocardial infarction, using English-language trial or observational studies reporting patient, caregiver, process, or systems outcomes within one year of hospital discharge.

sr_title: Indoor tanning and non-melanoma skin cancer: systematic review and meta-analysis.
research_objective: To synthesize evidence from English-language articles reporting an original effect statistic on indoor tanning and non-melanoma skin cancer, excluding articles presenting no data, such as reviews and editorials, and to examine the relative risk for ever use versus never use, dose-response effects, exposure during early life, and the population attributable risk fraction for the United States population.

sr_title: Promoting a culture of safety as a patient safety strategy: a systematic review.
research_objective: To identify and assess interventions targeting health care workers in inpatient acute care settings to promote patient safety culture or climate, using studies that report changes in safety culture or climate after an intervention.

sr_title: Coronary artery calcium score prediction of all cause mortality and cardiovascular events in people with type 2 diabetes: systematic review and meta-analysis.
research_objective: To investigate the association between baseline coronary artery calcium score and subsequent all-cause mortality or fatal and non-fatal cardiovascular events in people with type 2 diabetes, using prospective observational studies.

sr_title: Intake of fish and marine n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids and risk of breast cancer: meta-analysis of data from 21 independent prospective cohort studies.
research_objective: To examine the association between fish and n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acid intake, or tissue biomarkers of n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids, and breast cancer risk, including potential dose-response relationships, in prospective cohort studies reporting relative risks and 95% confidence intervals.

sr_title: Severe hypoglycaemia and cardiovascular disease: systematic review and meta-analysis with bias analysis.
research_objective: To quantitatively summarize the association between severe hypoglycaemia and cardiovascular events in people with type 2 diabetes, and to examine the sensitivity of this association to possible uncontrolled confounding by unmeasured comorbid severe illness using bias analysis, based on cohort studies excluding acute hospital settings.

sr_title: Preventing sexual abusers of children from reoffending: systematic review of medical and psychological interventions.
research_objective: To evaluate the effectiveness of medical and psychological interventions designed to prevent reoffending among known sexual abusers of children and to prevent sexual abuse of children by individuals at risk, using randomised controlled trials and prospective observational studies, with outcomes of arrests, convictions, breaches of conditions, and self-reported sexual abuse of children after one year or more.

sr_title: Effect of smoking on comparative efficacy of antiplatelet agents: systematic review, meta-analysis, and indirect comparison.
research_objective: To evaluate whether smoking status is associated with the efficacy of clopidogrel, prasugrel, or ticagrelor for preventing cardiovascular events, based on clinical outcomes among smokers and nonsmokers in randomized trials.

sr_title: Comparative effectiveness of renin-angiotensin system blockers and other antihypertensive drugs in patients with diabetes: systematic review and bayesian network meta-analysis.
research_objective: To assess the effects of antihypertensive treatment classes, including monotherapy and combination therapy, on survival and major renal outcomes in patients with diabetes, using randomised clinical trials of ACE inhibitors, ARBs, α blockers, β blockers, calcium channel blockers, diuretics, or their combinations, with at least 12 months of follow-up and reporting all-cause mortality, requirement for dialysis, or doubling of serum creatinine levels.

sr_title: The accessibility of firearms and risk for suicide and homicide victimization among household members: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
research_objective: To examine current estimates of the association between firearm availability and suicide or homicide, comparing participants with and without firearm access, across all study types.

sr_title: Functional status and quality of life after transcatheter aortic valve replacement: a systematic review.
research_objective: To evaluate changes in functional status and quality of life after transcatheter aortic valve replacement, including changes in New York Heart Association class, Short Form-12/36 physical and mental component scores, and other measures of functional status.

sr_title: Effect of screening sigmoidoscopy and screening colonoscopy on colorectal cancer incidence and mortality: systematic review and meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials and observational studies.
research_objective: To review and compare evidence from English-language randomised controlled trials and observational studies on the effectiveness of screening sigmoidoscopy and screening colonoscopy in preventing colorectal cancer incidence and mortality in the general population at average risk.

sr_title: Leucocyte telomere length and risk of cardiovascular disease: systematic review and meta-analysis.
research_objective: To assess the association between leucocyte telomere length and risk of coronary heart disease, defined as non-fatal myocardial infarction, coronary heart disease death, or coronary revascularisation, and cerebrovascular disease, defined as non-fatal stroke or death from cerebrovascular disease, in prospective and retrospective studies broadly representative of general populations that did not select cohort or control participants on the basis of pre-existing cardiovascular disease or diabetes.

sr_title: A community empowerment approach to the HIV response among sex workers: effectiveness, challenges, and considerations for implementation and scale-up.
research_objective: To examine community empowerment approaches for addressing HIV among sex workers, including their effectiveness in low-income and middle-income countries and the challenges and considerations for implementation and scale-up.

sr_title: Blood glucose concentration and risk of pancreatic cancer: systematic review and dose-response meta-analysis.
research_objective: To evaluate potential linear and non-linear dose-response relations between blood glucose concentration and risk of pancreatic cancer in prospective observational studies.

sr_title: Quantifying and monitoring overdiagnosis in cancer screening: a systematic review of methods.
research_objective: To determine the optimal methods for quantifying and monitoring overdiagnosis over time in screening for prostate, breast, lung, colorectal, melanoma, bladder, renal, thyroid, and uterine cancers, by reviewing English-language primary research studies of any design that quantified overdiagnosis, excluding case series, case reports, and reviews reporting only results of other studies.

sr_title: Methotrexate use and risk of lung disease in psoriasis, psoriatic arthritis, and inflammatory bowel disease: systematic literature review and meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials.
research_objective: To evaluate the relative risk of pulmonary disease in adults with psoriasis, psoriatic arthritis, or inflammatory bowel disease treated with methotrexate versus placebo or active comparator agents, using double-blind randomised controlled trials of at least 50 participants and 12 weeks’ duration, with outcomes including total, infectious, and non-infectious respiratory adverse events, interstitial lung disease, and death.

sr_title: Risk of recurrent stillbirth: systematic review and meta-analysis.
research_objective: To determine the risk of stillbirth in a subsequent pregnancy associated with stillbirth in an initial pregnancy, including unexplained stillbirth, in cohort and case-control studies conducted in high-income countries. Stillbirth was defined as fetal death after 20 weeks’ gestation or a birth weight of at least 400 g.

sr_title: Consumption of sugar sweetened beverages, artificially sweetened beverages, and fruit juice and incidence of type 2 diabetes: systematic review, meta-analysis, and estimation of population attributable fraction.
research_objective: To examine prospective associations between consumption of sugar sweetened beverages, artificially sweetened beverages, and fruit juice and incidence of type 2 diabetes among adults without diabetes, before and after adjustment for adiposity, and to estimate the population attributable fraction for type 2 diabetes associated with sugar sweetened beverage consumption in the United States and United Kingdom, using prospective studies and national survey data.

sr_title: Diagnostic prediction models for suspected pulmonary embolism: systematic review and independent external validation in primary care.
research_objective: To identify and independently externally validate all diagnostic prediction models for ruling out suspected acute pulmonary embolism that are easily applicable in primary care, assess their transportability to primary care, and compare their discriminative ability, sensitivity, specificity, efficiency, and failure rate, including when model cut-offs are combined with a qualitative D-dimer test.

sr_title: Calcium intake and risk of fracture: systematic review.
research_objective: To examine evidence on whether increasing calcium intake through dietary sources, including milk or dairy, or calcium supplements, with or without vitamin D, prevents fractures in people aged over 50, based on randomised controlled trials and cohort studies assessing fracture as an outcome.

sr_title: Calcium intake and bone mineral density: systematic review and meta-analysis.
research_objective: To determine whether increasing calcium intake from dietary sources affects bone mineral density in participants aged over 50, and whether its effects are similar to those of calcium supplements with or without vitamin D, in randomised controlled trials measuring bone mineral density at the lumbar spine, total hip, femoral neck, total body, or forearm.

sr_title: Comparative Effect of Contrast Media Type on the Incidence of Contrast-Induced Nephropathy: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
research_objective: To compare the risk of contrast-induced nephropathy among patients receiving low-osmolar or iso-osmolar contrast media for diagnostic or therapeutic imaging, within and between osmolality classes, using randomized controlled trials reporting contrast-induced nephropathy-related outcomes.

sr_title: Effectiveness of Prevention Strategies for Contrast-Induced Nephropathy: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
research_objective: To evaluate the comparative effectiveness of N-acetylcysteine, sodium bicarbonate, statins, and ascorbic acid for preventing contrast-induced nephropathy in adults receiving intravenous or intra-arterial contrast media, using randomized controlled trials that defined contrast-induced nephropathy and provided sufficient data for meta-analysis.

sr_title: Diabetes mellitus as a compelling indication for use of renin angiotensin system blockers: systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized trials.
research_objective: To evaluate outcomes with renin angiotensin system blockers compared with other antihypertensive agents in people with diabetes mellitus, using randomized controlled trials and examining death, cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, angina, stroke, heart failure, revascularization, and end stage renal disease.

sr_title: Developing a New Definition and Assessing New Clinical Criteria for Septic Shock: For the Third International Consensus Definitions for Sepsis and Septic Shock (Sepsis-3).
research_objective: To develop a new definition and clinical criteria for identifying septic shock in adults by systematically reviewing observational studies to determine the clinical criteria reported for septic shock, using a Delphi process to reach consensus, and testing the identified variables in cohort studies.

sr_title: Addition of dipeptidyl peptidase-4 inhibitors to sulphonylureas and risk of hypoglycaemia: systematic review and meta-analysis.
research_objective: To quantify the risk of hypoglycaemia with concomitant dipeptidyl peptidase-4 inhibitors and sulphonylureas compared with placebo and sulphonylureas in people with type 2 diabetes, using placebo-controlled randomised trials comprising at least 50 participants.

sr_title: Preoperative Frailty Assessment and Outcomes at 6 Months or Later in Older Adults Undergoing Cardiac Surgical Procedures: A Systematic Review.
research_objective: To evaluate frailty instruments for predicting mortality, functional status, or major adverse cardiovascular and cerebrovascular events in adults aged 60 years or older undergoing major or minimally invasive cardiac surgical procedures, based on cohort studies evaluating associations between frailty and mortality or functional status at 6 months or later.

sr_title: Non-specific immunological effects of selected routine childhood immunisations: systematic review.
research_objective: The review aimed to identify, assemble, and review human randomised controlled trials, cohort studies, and case-control studies reporting non-specific or heterologous immunological effects after routine vaccination with standard childhood immunisations, specifically BCG, measles, measles-mumps-rubella (MMR), diphtheria, tetanus, and pertussis vaccines. Studies using recombinant vaccines, no vaccine at all, or reporting only vaccine-specific outcomes were excluded.

sr_title: Management of Gout: A Systematic Review in Support of an American College of Physicians Clinical Practice Guideline.
research_objective: To review evidence on treatments for acute gout attacks, management of hyperuricemia to prevent attacks, and discontinuation of medications for chronic gout in adults, focusing on drugs approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration and commonly prescribed by primary care physicians; effectiveness was evaluated in randomized trials, and adverse events in trials and observational studies.

sr_title: Diagnosis of Gout: A Systematic Review in Support of an American College of Physicians Clinical Practice Guideline.
research_objective: To assess the accuracy of clinical tests and classification algorithms for diagnosing gout in participants with joint inflammation and no previous definitive gout diagnosis, compared with monosodium urate crystal analysis of joint aspirate, using evidence from prospective cohort, cross-sectional, and case-control studies.

sr_title: Association Between Palliative Care and Patient and Caregiver Outcomes: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
research_objective: To determine the association of palliative care interventions with quality of life, symptom burden, survival, mood, advance care planning, site of death, health care satisfaction, resource utilization, and health care expenditures among adults with life-limiting illness and their caregivers, based on randomized clinical trials.

sr_title: The Effects of Pay-for-Performance Programs on Health, Health Care Use, and Processes of Care: A Systematic Review.
research_objective: To update and expand a prior review of the effects of pay-for-performance programs targeted at the physician, group, managerial, or institutional level on processes of care, health, and health care utilization in ambulatory and inpatient settings, based on trials and observational studies reporting these outcomes.

sr_title: Interventions to Improve Follow-up of Positive Results on Fecal Blood Tests: A Systematic Review.
research_objective: To evaluate interventions intended to improve follow-up colonoscopy rates among asymptomatic adults with positive guaiac or immunochemical fecal test results, based on English-language randomized and nonrandomized studies.

sr_title: Immune-related adverse events for anti-PD-1 and anti-PD-L1 drugs: systematic review and meta-analysis.
research_objective: To evaluate rates of serious organ-specific immune-related adverse events, general adverse events related to immune activation, and adverse events consistent with musculoskeletal problems associated with anti-PD-1 drugs, overall and compared with control treatments, in patients with recurrent or metastatic cancer, using primary clinical trial data.

sr_title: Environmental toxic metal contaminants and risk of cardiovascular disease: systematic review and meta-analysis.
research_objective: To systematically review and meta-analyze epidemiological studies reporting risk estimates for the association between levels of arsenic, lead, cadmium, mercury, or copper and total cardiovascular disease, coronary heart disease, or stroke.

sr_title: Prevalence of Burnout Among Physicians: A Systematic Review.
research_objective: To characterize the methods used to assess burnout and estimate the point or period prevalence of questionnaire-assessed burnout among practicing physicians, excluding physicians in training.

sr_title: Clinical Outcomes Associated With Sickle Cell Trait: A Systematic Review.
research_objective: To evaluate associations between sickle cell trait and any of 24 clinical outcomes specified a priori in children or adults, including exertion-related injury; renal, vascular, pediatric, and surgery- or trauma-related outcomes; and overall mortality, in observational controlled studies published in English.

sr_title: Comparative safety of immune checkpoint inhibitors in cancer: systematic review and network meta-analysis.
research_objective: To examine the toxicity profile, toxicity spectrum, and safety ranking of immune checkpoint inhibitor drugs for cancer treatment, including treatment-related adverse events reported at the site, organ, or system level. Eligible evidence comprised English-language head-to-head phase II or III randomised controlled trials comparing any two or three of nivolumab, pembrolizumab, ipilimumab, tremelimumab, atezolizumab, conventional therapy (chemotherapy, targeted therapy, or their combinations), two immune checkpoint inhibitor drugs, or one immune checkpoint inhibitor drug with conventional therapy, including comparisons of different doses of the same drug; high-quality single-arm trials and placebo-controlled trials of immune checkpoint inhibitor drugs were selected to establish a validation group.

sr_title: Operative treatment versus nonoperative treatment of Achilles tendon ruptures: systematic review and meta-analysis.
research_objective: The review aimed to compare re-rupture rate, complication rate, and functional outcome after operative versus nonoperative treatment of acute Achilles tendon ruptures; compare re-rupture rates after early versus late full weight bearing and after functional rehabilitation with early range of motion; and compare effect estimates from randomised controlled trials and observational studies. Eligible studies were randomised controlled trials and observational studies comparing operative with nonoperative treatment.

sr_title: Pharmacologic and Nonpharmacologic Treatments for Urinary Incontinence in Women: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-analysis of Clinical Outcomes.
research_objective: To compare the effectiveness of pharmacologic and nonpharmacologic interventions for improving or curing stress, urgency, or mixed urinary incontinence in nonpregnant women, using randomized trials reporting categorical cure or improvement outcomes.

sr_title: Comparative efficacy and acceptability of non-surgical brain stimulation for the acute treatment of major depressive episodes in adults: systematic review and network meta-analysis.
research_objective: To estimate the comparative clinical efficacy and acceptability of electroconvulsive therapy, transcranial magnetic stimulation (repetitive, accelerated, priming, deep, and synchronised), theta burst stimulation, magnetic seizure therapy, and transcranial direct current stimulation, compared with sham therapy or each other, for the acute treatment of major depressive episodes in adults. Eligible studies were clinical trials with random allocation to one of these interventions or sham therapy. Outcomes of interest were response, all-cause discontinuation, remission, and continuous depression severity scores after treatment.

sr_title: New WHO prevalence estimates of mental disorders in conflict settings: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
research_objective: To update WHO estimates of the prevalence of depression, anxiety disorders, post-traumatic stress disorder, bipolar disorder, and schizophrenia in conflict-affected settings that had experienced conflict less than 10 years previously, and to calculate the burden per 1000 population.

sr_title: Population-level impact and herd effects following the introduction of human papillomavirus vaccination programmes: updated systematic review and meta-analysis.
research_objective: To examine the population-level impact in real-world settings of HPV vaccination programmes vaccinating girls and women, including the impact of multiple age-cohort vaccination, on genital HPV infections, anogenital wart diagnoses, and histologically confirmed CIN2+. Eligible studies compared the prevalence or incidence of at least one of these endpoints between pre-vaccination and post-vaccination periods in the general population, using the same population sources and recruitment methods before and after vaccination.

sr_title: Prognostic models for outcome prediction in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: systematic review and critical appraisal.
research_objective: The review aimed to map and assess prognostic models for predicting any potential clinical outcome in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, including studies that developed, validated, or updated a prediction model.

sr_title: Efficacy and safety of first line treatments for patients with advanced epidermal growth factor receptor mutated, non-small cell lung cancer: systematic review and network meta-analysis.
research_objective: To compare the efficacy and safety of first-line treatments for patients with advanced EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer, using published or unpublished randomized controlled trials comparing two or more treatments and reporting progression-free survival, overall survival, objective response rate, or grade 3 or higher adverse events.

sr_title: Comparative efficacy and safety of new surgical treatments for benign prostatic hyperplasia: systematic review and network meta-analysis.
research_objective: To assess the efficacy and safety of endoscopic surgical treatments for benign prostatic hyperplasia by comparing randomised controlled trials of prostate vapourisation, resection, and enucleation using monopolar, bipolar, or holmium, thulium, potassium titanyl phosphate, or diode laser systems. Outcomes of interest were maximal flow rate (Qmax) and International Prostate Symptom Score (IPSS) at 12 months, Qmax and IPSS at 6, 24, and 36 months, perioperative parameters, and surgical complications.

sr_title: Malpractice Liability and Health Care Quality: A Review.
research_objective: To examine empirical evidence on the association between malpractice liability risk—including measures such as malpractice insurance premiums, tort reforms, claims and payments, jury awards, immunity from liability, and composite measures—and health care quality and safety, including health outcomes and structural and process indicators of care.

sr_title: Occurrence, prevention, and management of the psychological effects of emerging virus outbreaks on healthcare workers: rapid review and meta-analysis.
research_objective: To examine the psychological effects on healthcare staff of working with patients during outbreaks of emerging viruses in any clinical setting, irrespective of comparison with other clinicians or the general population, and successful measures to manage stress and psychological distress.

sr_title: Association of Blood Pressure Lowering With Incident Dementia or Cognitive Impairment: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
research_objective: To determine the association of blood pressure lowering with dementia or cognitive impairment, cognitive decline, and changes in cognitive test scores, compared with placebo, alternative antihypertensive agents, or higher blood pressure targets, in randomized clinical trials.

sr_title: Ventilation Techniques and Risk for Transmission of Coronavirus Disease, Including COVID-19: A Living Systematic Review of Multiple Streams of Evidence.
research_objective: To examine the benefits and harms of ventilation techniques for coronavirus infections, including COVID-19, by comparing oxygenation approaches in patients with coronavirus infections, including SARS or MERS, or hypoxemic respiratory failure; the review also considered studies of any design and language, animal, mechanistic, laboratory and preclinical evidence on coronavirus aerosol dispersion, and studies of virus transmission to health care workers from aerosol-generating procedures.

sr_title: Hydroxychloroquine or Chloroquine for Treatment or Prophylaxis of COVID-19: A Living Systematic Review.
research_objective: To summarize evidence on the benefits and harms of hydroxychloroquine or chloroquine for treatment or prophylaxis of COVID-19, based on studies in any language reporting efficacy or safety outcomes in any setting among adults or children with suspected COVID-19 or at risk for SARS-CoV-2 infection.

sr_title: Using Electronic Health Record Portals to Improve Patient Engagement: Research Priorities and Best Practices.
research_objective: To identify research on patient engagement with electronic health record data through patient portals to inform best practices and priorities for future research.

sr_title: Association of Noninvasive Oxygenation Strategies With All-Cause Mortality in Adults With Acute Hypoxemic Respiratory Failure: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
research_objective: To compare the association of high-flow nasal oxygen, face mask noninvasive ventilation, and helmet noninvasive ventilation with standard oxygen therapy in adults with acute hypoxemic respiratory failure, assessing all-cause mortality and endotracheal intubation in randomized clinical trials.

sr_title: Effects of Intensive Blood Pressure Treatment on Orthostatic Hypotension : A Systematic Review and Individual Participant-based Meta-analysis.
research_objective: To examine the effects of intensive pharmacologic blood pressure treatment on orthostatic hypotension in adults with hypertension or elevated blood pressure, using randomized trials of more intensive blood pressure goals or active agents compared with less intensive goals or placebo. Eligible trials involved more than 500 adults and lasted at least 6 months.

sr_title: Associations between high temperatures in pregnancy and risk of preterm birth, low birth weight, and stillbirths: systematic review and meta-analysis.
research_objective: The review aimed to assess whether exposure to high environmental temperatures during pregnancy is associated with preterm birth, low birth weight, and stillbirth, using evidence from clinical studies.

sr_title: Intravenous alteplase for stroke with unknown time of onset guided by advanced imaging: systematic review and meta-analysis of individual patient data.
research_objective: To establish whether intravenous alteplase is safe and effective compared with standard of care or placebo in adults with stroke of unknown time of onset in whom salvageable tissue has been identified with imaging biomarkers (perfusion-diffusion MRI, perfusion CT, or MRI with DWI-FLAIR mismatch), using an individual patient data meta-analysis of randomised trials.

sr_title: Efficacy and safety of lowering LDL cholesterol in older patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials.
research_objective: To summarise evidence on LDL cholesterol-lowering therapies in patients aged 75 years or older, using randomised controlled trials of cardiovascular outcomes of drugs recommended by the 2018 American College of Cardiology and American Heart Association guidelines, with a median follow-up of at least 2 years and data on older patients; trials exclusively enrolling participants with heart failure or on dialysis are excluded. The outcome of interest is major vascular events (cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction or other acute coronary syndrome, stroke, or coronary revascularisation), assessed per 1 mmol/L reduction in LDL cholesterol.

sr_title: Efficacy and safety of low and very low carbohydrate diets for type 2 diabetes remission: systematic review and meta-analysis of published and unpublished randomized trial data.
research_objective: To determine the efficacy and safety of low carbohydrate diets (<130 g/day or <26% of a 2000 kcal/day diet) and very low carbohydrate diets (<10% of calories from carbohydrates) for adults with type 2 diabetes, including their effect on diabetes remission, based on randomized clinical trials lasting at least 12 weeks.

sr_title: Efficacy and safety of antidepressants for the treatment of back pain and osteoarthritis: systematic review and meta-analysis.
research_objective: To investigate the efficacy and safety of any antidepressant compared with active or inert placebo in randomised controlled trials involving participants with low back or neck pain, sciatica, or hip or knee osteoarthritis, focusing on pain and disability as primary outcomes and adverse events, serious adverse events, and withdrawals due to adverse events as secondary outcomes.

sr_title: Comparative effectiveness of treatments for open-angle glaucoma: a systematic review for the U.S. Preventive Services Task Force.
research_objective: To compare the effectiveness of medical, laser, and surgical treatments in adults with open-angle glaucoma for decreasing intraocular pressure and preventing optic nerve damage, vision loss, and visual impairment, using English-language systematic reviews, randomized controlled trials, and quasi-randomized controlled trials for most outcomes, and observational studies for quality of life and harms.
